name: Bashal'Aran
summary: Magic still binds Asterion beneath Bashal'Aran's broken stones. The ancient night elf seeks release from his ghostly form and suspects the grells have touched the seal that holds him. He asks travelers to gather their earrings and trace its lingering magic.

sections.title: A Centuries-Old Torment
sections.body: For centuries, Asterion has waited among Bashal'Aran's shattered marble. The ancient night elf spirit remains caught between life and true death beneath Darkshore's canopy. Arcane craft binds him to the ruined settlement, and he cannot break free alone. Solitude and despair have worn down his mind.

sections.title: Traces in the Wild
sections.body: Asterion believes an ancient seal hidden in the ruins may hold the key to his release. He cannot search the brush and fallen stones himself. The feral grells of Bashal'Aran forage there and steal small baubles, so he asks travelers to gather their earrings. He hopes the trinkets' lingering magic will lead him to the seal that torments his soul.

aliases: who is the ghost in bashal'aran
faq.answer: Asterion is an ancient night elf ghost bound to Bashal'Aran's ruins in Darkshore. A mystical seal has held him in torment for centuries, and he longs to be free of his spectral state.

faq.q: Why does Asterion want grell earrings?
faq.answer: Asterion believes the grells have touched the seal that binds him. Their earrings may carry traces of its magic and help him find it.
Bashal'Aran lies in Darkshore's forested coast, an ancient night elf ruin from before the Great Sundering. Wild grells, satyrs, and spectral remnants of its fallen inhabitants roam there.

faq.q: What happens after collecting the earrings?
aliases: did the grells have the seal
faq.answer: After travelers gather the earrings, Asterion examines them. He senses the grells brushed against the seal in what he considers recent times, though they do not carry it. This lets him narrow down its location in the ruins.
An ancient magical seal bound Asterion to Bashal'Aran centuries ago. It anchors his spirit to the ruins and keeps him from finding peaceful rest.
Grells are small, malicious woodland creatures native to Kalimdor's forests. They have sharp claws, favor trinkets, and often infest old ruins and attack travelers.

angles.text: As a Kaldorei, you may see Asterion as a reminder of the ancient civilization lost in the Sundering and of souls bound in ruin for millennia.
As a mage, you may recognize Asterion's use of enchanted trinkets to trace lingering magic as an ancient Highborne practice of arcane divination.
As an Alliance traveler, you help pacify Darkshore's treacherous northern reaches by clearing the chaotic grells around Bashal'Aran.
